name: pdh_pdl_fakeout_v141
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, Previous Day High and Low are the most-referenced technical levels by retail stop-loss placement, options strike clustering, and institutional VWAP desks. When the index probes above PDH intraday, cascading stop-buy orders and breakout algos create a brief overshooting spike — but large institutional VWAP desks do not chase pokes above PDH, leaving only fast-money longs who entered the spike exposed. Within 30-90 seconds the spike fails, and option market makers who are short gamma near these strike-proximate levels delta-hedge aggressively on reversal, amplifying the return below PDH. The fakeout bar itself (5s bar has high > PDH but closes back below) is the cleanest entry signal available at 5-second resolution.

indicators.name: pdh
indicators.purpose: Previous day high — a daily reference level, no frequency scaling needed. This is the exact liquidity pool level NIFTY probes to trigger retail stop-buy orders and breakout algos.

indicators.name: pdl
indicators.purpose: Previous day low — symmetric to PDH. A daily reference level. No frequency scaling. Represents the liquidity pool below where stop-sell orders cluster.

indicators.name: breach_up
indicators.purpose: Magnitude of the upward probe above PDH in index points. Used to reject genuine breakouts (breach > 15 pts on NIFTY typically signals real directional flow, not a liquidity hunt spike).

indicators.name: breach_dn
indicators.purpose: Magnitude of the downward probe below PDL in index points. Symmetric filter — same 15pt cutoff for rejecting genuine breakdowns.

conditions: high > pdh (bar probed above PDH — stop hunts triggered)
close < pdh (bar closed back below PDH — rejection confirmed in this 5s bar)
breach_up < max_breach_pts (default 15 pts — spike no larger than 15 index pts, else genuine breakout)
vix < vix_max (default 22 — above 22, panic conditions turn fakeouts into real breakouts)
buy_pe.confirmation: Close below PDH on the same 5s bar is the signal — no additional bar needed

conditions: low < pdl (bar probed below PDL — stop hunts triggered)
close > pdl (bar closed back above PDL — rejection confirmed in this 5s bar)
breach_dn < max_breach_pts (default 15 pts — drop no larger than 15 index pts, else genuine breakdown)
buy_ce.confirmation: Close above PDL on the same 5s bar is the signal

exit.stop_rationale: If the reversal from PDH fakeout stalls and NIFTY option premium rises 5 pts (~10 spot pts), the short-gamma amplification has flipped and the breakout is resuming. A 5-pt option stop corresponds to ~10 NIFTY spot pts — more than 2× the median fakeout probe size, so this is not hair-trigger.
exit.target_rationale: PDH/PDL fakeout reversals on NIFTY typically cover 15-25 spot pts in the first 30-60 seconds as trapped longs cover. At ATM delta ~0.5, that is 7.5-12.5 option pts. Target of 8 pts captures roughly the lower half of this range (1:1.6 R:R).

filters.vix_filter: vix < 22 — above 22 macro panic turns fakeouts into directional breakouts

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — behavioral edge from retail stop placement, but algos increasingly front-run PDH/PDL levels

adaptation_notes: Original operated on nifty200 individual stocks at 15-min bars with 2.5-7.5 hour holds targeting VWAP reversion after PDH/PDL fakeout. Converted to NIFTY INDEX's own PDH/PDL which are even more watched than any single stock's levels (entire derivatives ecosystem prices around them). Hold compressed from hours to 15-90 seconds — we capture only the initial sharp reversal, not the slow VWAP drift. ATR-based stop replaced with fixed option point stop. Entry logic (high > PDH, close < PDH) maps identically to 5s bars — the fakeout bar is self-contained regardless of timeframe.
weaknesses: Strong macro news (Fed, RBI policy) can convert PDH fakeout into genuine breakout
PDH/PDL triggers at most once or twice per day per direction — low signal frequency
On narrow-range days, PDH/PDL may be only a few points from current price, generating noisy signals all session
First 15 minutes of session: PDH/PDL probes are common noise — session filter starts at 09:20
